title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Boil pasta. Cook bacon. Mix eggs and cheese. Combine all together.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken cooked in creamy tomato gravy.
instructions: Grill chicken. Prepare sauce. Combine and simmer.
